key_highlights: Brent crude spikes to $108/barrel on Saudi pipeline shutdown, pressuring RBA policy and fuel costs; Albanese faces pressure for second excise cut
Iron ore crash confirmed, posing severe downside risk to BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX revenue and dividends
Fed on track for September rate hike amid oil-driven inflation; bond yields rising, pressuring AUD and global risk assets
ASX treads water as oil spike offsets AI-sector volatility; Anthropic/OpenAI CEOs warn of AI slowdown, spooking tech traders globally
ANZ.AX restructuring continues post-3,500 job cuts; private hospital operator collapses, signalling stress in healthcare sector
Australian housing market shows no spring bounce; auction activity weak, raising questions on REIT and construction exposure
Gold exploration positives: Forrestania secures 2Mt WA deal, PLC Resources expands target; Critica unveils 19Mt tin-tungsten deposit

sectors.trend: Iron ore crash is the dominant negative; gold and critical minerals (tin-tungsten, graphite) show relative strength
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression and dividend risk. Gold miners (NVS.AX, GRC.AX) and critical minerals (CRX.AX, SRY.AX) offer relative outperformance. Steel sector under pressure from job cuts.

sectors.trend: Brent at $108 on Saudi pipeline shutdown; Australia nears energy inflection point; fuel blowout pressures consumers
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil spike. However, higher fuel costs squeeze QAN.AX, SYD.AX margins and consumer discretionary. RBA hawkish bias likely.

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX restructuring ongoing; rising bond yields support NIM but credit risk from housing softness looms
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX benefit from higher yields but face housing-linked credit risk. ANZ.AX restructuring execution is a key watch item.

sectors.trend: Major private hospital operator collapses and is being divided; sector stress signals
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, IAG.AX (health insurance) face indirect pressure. Hospital operator collapse may create M&A opportunities but signals sector fragility.

sectors.trend: Housing auction market flat; caravan manufacturer shuts; fuel costs squeeze discretionary spend
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy and rate sensitivity. WES.AX, WOW.AX pressured by fuel-driven cost inflation. Caravan/vehicle sector (RVH.AX) under stress.

sectors.trend: Anthropic and OpenAI CEOs warn of AI slowdown; global tech sell-off; SoftBank shares plunge
sectors.implications: Limited direct ASX exposure but sentiment spillover affects global tech. Australian tech (W1.AX, XRO.AX) may see reduced capital flows. AI capex cycle at inflection.

key_themes: Oil-driven inflation vs. iron ore deflation: dual commodity shock creating policy dilemma for RBA
Fed September hike risk elevates global risk-off sentiment and pressures AUD
AI narrative shift from hype to caution; potential tech de-rating
Australian housing market in structural soft patch; no spring bounce
Critical minerals and gold exploration remain a bright spot in materials
Corporate stress in healthcare and consumer manufacturing sectors
China trade policy pivot and tariff dynamics affecting supply chains

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; hedge with gold miners; monitor China stimulus signals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil spike driving inflation and Fed hike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight energy (WDS.AX, WLE.AX); underweight rate-sensitive REITs and growth; monitor AUD/USD

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market deterioration and credit risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor NAB.AX, CBA.AX loan loss provisions; reduce REIT exposure; watch auction clearance rates

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AI sector de-rating and tech volatility
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid chasing AI momentum; favour cash-generative large caps; monitor global tech index
Avoid distressed operators; monitor CSL.AX, SGH.AX for sector spillover; avoid small-cap consumer manufacturing

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Australian energy producers on oil spike
opportunities.rationale: Brent at $108 on supply disruption; WDS.AX and WLE.AX benefit directly from sustained premium

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into gold and critical minerals as iron ore weakens
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore crash diverts capital to gold (Forrestania, PLC Resources) and critical minerals (Critica tin-tungsten, Sarytogan graphite)
Fed hike and rising bond yields support NIMs; CBA.AX and NAB.AX best positioned if credit losses remain contained

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and coal exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Confirmed iron ore crash; China demand pivot and tariff uncertainty create prolonged downside

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim REIT and rate-sensitive consumer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: No housing spring bounce; fuel costs squeeze discretionary; rising rates pressure valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash buffer ahead of Fed decision
defensive_moves.rationale: September Fed hike risk and oil-driven volatility warrant liquidity; AUD may weaken

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound to slightly lower. Oil spike supports energy but iron ore crash and Fed hike risk cap upside. AI volatility adds noise. Expect 2-3% downside risk into Fed meeting.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift in commodity mix (iron ore down, gold/critical minerals up) favours selective materials rotation. Housing softness and energy transition create medium-term headwinds for banks and REITs but tailwinds for energy and infrastructure. AI capex cycle may moderate, reducing tech multiple expansion.
